edit.description: `ProvisionFailure`'s doc loses the stray opener its body starts with, and `MergeOutcome`'s roster is one bullet per member again
the two arms: a shipped doc comment whose body opens with a second `/**`, and the union whose roster must name one bullet per member

summary: Two doc comments on `src/index.ts`-exported surface are malformed — a stray `/**` opening one body, and five of MergeOutcome's nine variants no longer bullets

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: the hover text a chain author reads for `ProvisionFailure` and `MergeOutcome` is well formed — no body opening with a second doc-comment opener, and one bullet per union member — and both properties are held by an arm of the pin that already owns shipped hover text rather than by review
notes: Verified on disk: `src/tickVerdict.ts:35` is a stray `/**` above the real opener at `:36`, so the shipped body starts with it; `MergeOutcome`'s roster (`:360`-`:404`) aligns four bullets and then runs `afterCommit-reverted`, `not-shipped`, `tip-moved`, `dropped-work` and `wave-walled` into the prose of the variant above. Both types are exported (`src/index.ts`). No existing arm reads either — `harness/init.ts:282` nests openers inside emitted template text and is out by construction.
tests: no doc comment the package ships opens with a second doc-comment opener
MergeOutcome's doc names one bullet per member of the union
